අති විශෙෂ
No. 2438/29 - WEDNESDAY, MAY 28, 2025
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My Ref. No.: KDS/MIN/4/8/7-6. Ministry of lands Ref. No. : 4-3/18/2021/WS/179.
I hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the government intends to acquire the following land for a public purpose.

Description of land acquired to be obtained : The allotments of land, give as following name and extent, depicted in the preliminary plan No. Cadastral Map. 321001, block No. 01 sheet 02 and dated 23.12.2024, prepared by the Surveyor General, situated at the Village of Weragama, in No. 931, Weragama Grama Niladhari Division in Kanda Pahala Korale Minor Division, in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Minipe, in Kandy District, Central Province and bounded as follows :-

01. Lot No. 01 - Pallekanda Kelewa; Extent: 0.0482 Hectare. On the North by : Lot No. 108 in the FVP 300; On the East by : Lot No. 2 in sheet 1; On the South by : Lot No. 108 in the FVP 300; On the west by: Lot No. 2.
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk
(Published by Authority)
PART III — LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices

02. Lot No. 02 - Pallekanda Kelewa; Extent: 0.0556 Hectare. On the North by : Lot No. 108 in the FVP 300; On the East by : Lot No. 108 in FVP 300 and Lot No. 1 in the said plan; On the South by : Lot No. 108 in the FVP 300; On the west by: Lot No. 3.

All persons who claim ownership, interest or any other connection to the aforesaid land/servitude hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing before me on 19th of August 2025 at 10.00 a.m. at the Divisional Secretariat, Minipe.

And further, you are requested to notify me in writing (in duplicated) before 20th of July, 2025 the nature of their interests in the land/lands, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said lands/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. Deeds of the claims shall be presented at the inquiry.
A. D. Thilakarathne, Divisional Secretary, Minipe. 21st May, 2025, At Divisional Secretariat, Minipe. EOG 05 - 0201

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My Ref. No.: KDS/MIN/4/8/7-11. Ministry of lands Ref. No. : 4-3/18/2019/WS/380.
I hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of Land Acquisition Act, that the government intends to acquire the following land for a public purpose.

Description of land acquired to be obtained : The allotments of land, given as following name and extent, depicted in the preliminary plan No. Cad. 01. Lot No. 01 - Rathmetiyahena, Pallekanda Kelewa; Extent: 0.0198 Hectare. North by : Lot No. 108 and 84 in the FVP 300; East by : Lot No. 84 in the FVP 300; South by : Lot Nos. 84 and 108 in the FVP 300; West by: Lot No. 2.

02. Lot No. 02 - Rathmetiyahena, Pallekanda Kelewa; Extent: 0.0095 Hectare. North by : Lot No. 108 in the FVP 300; East by : Lot No. 108 in FVP 300 and Lot No. 1 in the said plan; South by : Lot No. 108 in the FVP 300; West by: Lot No. 108 in the FVP 300.

All persons who claim ownership, interest or any other connection to the aforesaid land/servitude hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing before me on 19th of August, 2025 at 10.00 a.m. at the Divisional Secretariat, Minipe.

And further, you are hereby requested to notify me in writing (in duplicate) before 20th of July, 2025 the nature of their interests in the land/lands, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said lands/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. Deeds of the claims shall be presented at the inquiry.
A. D. Thilakarathne, Divisional Secretary, Minipe. 21st May, 2025, At Divisional Secretariat, Minipe. EOG 05 - 0202
